title: Not a suction cup but works with adhesion really
text:
Not a suction cup but works with adhesion really. Let's start with the good. This is an inexpensive shower caddy that they claim is stainless steel and should not rust, well only time will tell. Most of the ones they claim don't rust end up rusting eventually. It is a nice small caddy that you can fit in any shower really no matter how small. It has 4 nice little hooks for your shaver or loofah or whatever you want to hang on it. This caddy has enough space for your shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, the essentials really. It is very easy to install, minutes really. Just clean the area, attach the little suction cups although they aren't really suction cups, and then attach the caddy to them.

Now my issue, well it is the suction cups. They claim they are suction cups but they really aren't. They attach with these little clear discs that STICK to your tiles. So we will see how strong this sticky disc is and how long it will last. I have another one similar to this one and it is a true suction cup mechanism. I did not like the fact that these attach permanently to my tiles to be honest. Plus once you attach the caddy to the "suction cups" they are not really that secure and solidly attached, they can still be moved back and forth on it.

So all in all this is not bad, but I am not a huge fan on the permanence on it and not sure how long this will really last. For that i am giving it just 3 stars.
